definitions.explanation: The place or door through which you leave a building or area.

examples.japanese: {出口|でぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧{出口|でぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: How many exits does the station have?

examples.japanese: {出口|でぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't find the exit, so I walked around inside for a while.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東口|ひがしぐち}→東口：24067_higashiguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出口|でぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Go out the east exit and turn right, and you'll see the shop right away.

notes:
{出口|でぐち} means exit—the way out of a building or area.

COMPONENTS:
{出|で} (exit) + {口|ぐち} (opening) = way out

OPPOSITE:
⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧ (entrance) ↔ {出口|でぐち} (exit)

STATION EXITS:
- ⟦{東口|ひがしぐち}→東口：24067_higashiguchi⟧: east exit
- ⟦{西口|にしぐち}→西口：21655_nishiguchi⟧: west exit
- ⟦{南口|みなみぐち}→南口：24066_minamiguchi⟧: south exit
- ⟦{北口|きたぐち}→北口：11056_kitaguchi⟧: north exit
- ⟦{中央口|ちゅうおうぐち}→中央口：noentry⟧: central exit

OTHER 〜{口|ぐち} WORDS:
- ⟦{非常口|ひじょうぐち}→非常口：07045_hijouguchi⟧: emergency exit
- ⟦{改札口|かいさつぐち}→改札口：09552_kaisatsuguchi⟧: ticket gate
- ⟦{乗|の}り{口|ぐち}→乗り口：noentry⟧: boarding gate

USAGE:
{出口|でぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Where is the exit?) is a common question. Japanese stations often have multiple numbered/named exits.
